summary.text: Emily Yaw is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
An accountant and foster parent, she lists child safety, school funding and affordability among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Emily Yaw earned a bachelor's degree from Bethel College in 2009, and her career experience includes working as an accountant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a foster parent of six years who is involved in her church and studying to become a social worker.
She said it took almost five years for her to adopt her children from foster care.
Yaw said her key messages include prioritizing children's safety, funding schools, subsidizing childcare, raising the minimum wage and building affordable apartments.
She identified child welfare as the policy area she is most passionate about.
